parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: File name, which can be obtained through the API at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460565.html.

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: File Path, which can be obtained through the API at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460565.html.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.
